notes.title: 2025 Publisher Sale
notes.content:
[h3]Today kicks off the big [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/2LeftThumbs2025][b]2 Left Thumbs[/b] Publisher Sale[/url]![/h3]
Explore the full event page to scope out loads of discounts, free games, bundles and more!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/2LeftThumbs2025][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39217323/c11f237f089d5f895f0e8ba5921ebf80e931d8ee.png[/img][/url]

[h2]How about a FREE game?![/h2]
[b]Croak Crusader: Spawn of the Spore Spectre[/b] launched TODAY, and is available [u]100% for free[/u]!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2997920/Croak_Crusader_Spawn_of_the_Spore_Spectre/

This free title introduces the general gameplay, protagonist and antagonists of the upcoming (paid) release, [b]Croak Crusader: the Champion of Canada[/b]. Be sure to add that to your Wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3152060/Croak_Crusader_the_Champion_of_Canada/

[h2]COMING SOON[/h2]
Very VERY soon! [b]Novus Orbis[/b] is a combo-based roguelike deckbuilder, set to release into Early Access on [b]February 10th[/b]. There's already dozens of hours of content, and the game will only be getting deeper and more varied from here!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2437330/Novus_Orbis/

[h2]NEW UPDATES[/h2]
A collection of games have all timed free updates and big announcements for this event!

[h3]WizardChess[/h3]
[b]WizardChess[/b] is a chess-like tactical roguelike with a near infinitely replayable amount of variety and depth. And today takes us a step closer to FULLY infinite replayability, with the addition of Daily Runs!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1274210/WizardChess/

[h3]Starground[/h3]
At the end of 2024 [b]Starground[/b] revealed a planned [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2793380/view/539966570464543216]development roadmap[/url]. Today sees the [i]Brewconomic Cropdate[/i], adding animals, fishing, potion brewing, and an improved Space Hub.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2793380/Starground/

[h3]Magenta Horizon[/h3]
In addition to making the awesome art for this sale, solo-dev Maddison Baek has crafted new community items for [b]Magenta Horizon[/b]! Play the game to earn Trading Cards, and unlock awesome profile backgrounds and other Steam goodies.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2109060/Magenta_Horizon__Neverending_Harvest/

[h3]Schism[/h3]
[b]Schism[/b] has a new update dropping Feb 10th that adds some end-game content, and enhanced controller support. Keep your eyes peeled for that! But the BIG news here, is that Schism is leaving Early Access [u][b]MARCH 10th[/b][/u]!! [i]There is no discount now, so as not to conflict with that launch discount[/i].

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2084300/Schism/

[h3]Tower of Kalemonvo[/h3]
While this classic-style hack n slash ARPG isn't out yet, it did just receive yet another demo update. The name of the game right now is [i]polish[/i], preparing for our newly set released date of [u][b]MARCH 28th[/b][/u]!!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2351860/Tower_of_Kalemonvo/

notes.title: William and Sly 🦊 OUT NOW!!
notes.content:
[h2]WILLIAM AND SLY ARE BACK[/h2]
The hit Flash series, [b]William and Sly[/b], is returning as a 3d platforming adventure!
Explore an expansive wilderness landscape as a fox in search of mushrooms, and untangle the magical machinations of a dark enchantress.

[h3]Features[/h3]
[list][*] Open-world exploration
[*] Collectathon elements
[*] Minigames and secrets to discover
[*] No health, or enemies
[*] Painterly art style
[*] Tranquil, meditative OST[/list]
Collect over 400 mushrooms, uncover mini-games to play around in, and additional skills to enhance your traversal ability.

[previewyoutube=x3HLWPzgZps;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Soundtrack[/h3]
Lucas composed 15 original tracks for this game. This soundtrack WILL be for sale shortly, we just need to wait on final package approval from Steam. You'll be able to buy the game and OST together for an additional discount!

[h3]Bundles[/h3]
Are you a big-time platformer fan? Look no further!
This week is also the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/Retrovibe/sale/2dplatformervibes]2D Platformer Vibes[/url] event, being hosted by Retrovibe Games.
You can grab up 4 indie platforming titles together for a heavy discount:

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/37938/Ultimate_Platformer_Pack

Or perhaps you're a Flash game fanatic like myself?
Check out this collection of direct sequels to hit games from the golden age of browser gaming!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/39200/Flash_Game_Legasequels/

notes.title: Now Available: The Everloom
notes.content:
[h2]The Everloom[/h2]
With the help of [url=https://twitter.com/the_exp]Antony Lavelle[/url] (The-EXP), we have added [b]The Everloom[/b] as a free update to this Classic Collection. This is a relaxing pixel art adventure. Explore the environment, talk to the people, and swap key items - learning more of the same fantasy dreamworld that William and Sly also occupy.

We're so thrilled to be able to share this with fans, old and new. We hope William and Sly can find a new audience and second life here on Steam! Speaking of...

[h2]Upcoming Sequel[/h2]
These classic games are receiving a fully 3D sequel!
This new installment remains an open world platformer, with minigames, chill vibes, and collectathon driven exploration. Please be sure to add it to your [u]Wishlist[/u]!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2459620/William_and_Sly/

[h2]Series History[/h2]
Want to know more about the history and legacy of the [b]William and Sly[/b] series, dating back to the Golden Age of online Flash games? Check out this video:

[previewyoutube=53XPNCC6mOw;full][/previewyoutube]
Graeme (the Publisher) interviewed Lucas (the Developer) for a retrospective on the series. We talked about Flash development, WarCraft 3, Taoism, motivation, indie games, and everything in between!
